page.layout: One printed page. Running head/page number at top centre. Main text in one column: a title in capitals and italic dedication lines, then a paragraph of text. page.notes: The woodcut initial at the lower left is a decorative flourish initial (ornamented capital) and is not transcribed as text. The line "Ad Mandatum Cæsareæ Majestatis proprium" is set in italic and is the secretary's attestation; "Westner." is the secretary's name. Printed page number "162" appears at the top. Possible doubtful readings: "Dürer" and the "[?]" marks are not needed; the transcription follows the scan. The date "die xxix. Martii" appears as printed in the scan as "die x x 1 x.Martii", read here as xxix.; reading uncertain at the line end.
